entries.title: Romans 11:1
segments: I say then, Did not God put away His people? Let it not be [said]! For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of [the] tribe of Benjamin.

entries.title: Romans 11:2
segments: God did not thrust out His people whom He foreknew. Or do you not know what the Scripture said in Elijah, how he pleaded with God against Israel, saying,

entries.title: Romans 11:3
segments: "Lord, they killed Your prophets and dug down Your altars, and I am left alone, and they seek my life."

entries.title: Romans 11:4
segments: But what does the Divine answer say to him? "I have reserved to Myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal."

entries.title: Romans 11:5
segments: Even so then, also in this present time a remnant according to the election of grace has come into being.

entries.title: Romans 11:6
segments: But if by grace, then [it is] no more of works; otherwise grace is no more grace. But if [it is] of works, then it is no more of grace; otherwise work is no more work.

entries.title: Romans 11:7
segments: What then? Israel has not obtained that which it seeks, but the election obtained [it], and the rest were hardened

entries.title: Romans 11:8
segments: even as it is written, "God gave to them a spirit of slumber, eyes not seeing, and ears not hearing" until this day.

entries.title: Romans 11:9
segments: And David said, "Let their table become for a snare and a trap and a stumbling block and a recompense to them.

entries.title: Romans 11:10
segments: Let their eyes be darkened so that they may not see, and their back always bowing."

entries.title: Romans 11:11
segments: I say then, Did they not stumble that they fall? Let it not be! But by their slipping away came salvation to the nations, to provoke them to jealousy.

entries.title: Romans 11:12
segments: But if their slipping away [is] the riches of [the] world, and their default is [the] riches of [the] nations, how much more their fullness?

entries.title: Romans 11:13
segments: For I speak to you, the nations; since I am the apostle of the nations, I glorify my ministry;

entries.title: Romans 11:14
segments: if by any means I may provoke [those who are] my flesh to jealousy, and might save some of them.

entries.title: Romans 11:15
segments: For if their casting away [is the] reconciling of [the] world, what [is] the reception except life from [the] dead?

entries.title: Romans 11:16
segments: For if the firstfruit [is] holy, the lump [is] also [holy]; and if the root [is] holy, also the branches.

entries.title: Romans 11:17
segments: And if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were grafted in among them, and became a sharer of the root and the fatness of the olive tree with them,

entries.title: Romans 11:18
segments: do not boast against the branches. But if you boast, [it is] not you [that] bears the root, but the root bears you.

entries.title: Romans 11:19
segments: You will say then, The branches were broken off so that I might be grafted in.

entries.title: Romans 11:20
segments: Well, because of unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by faith. Do not [be] high-minded, but fear.

entries.title: Romans 11:21
segments: For if God did not spare the natural branches, [fear] lest He also may not spare you either!

entries.title: Romans 11:22
segments: Behold then [the] kindness, and [the] severity of God; on those having fallen, severity; but on you, kindness, if you continue in the kindness. Otherwise you also will be cut off.

entries.title: Romans 11:23
segments: And those also, if they do not continue in unbelief, will be grafted in. For God is able to graft them in again.

entries.title: Romans 11:24
segments: For if you were cut out of the natural wild olive [tree], and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive [tree]; how much more these [being] according to nature will be grafted into [their] own olive-tree?

entries.title: Romans 11:25
segments: For I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers, lest you should be wise within yourselves; that blindness in part has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the nations has comes in.

entries.title: Romans 11:26
segments: And so all Israel shall be saved; as it is written, "There shall come out of Zion the Deliverer, and He will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

entries.title: Romans 11:27
segments: For this [is] My covenant with them, when I have taken away their sins."

entries.title: Romans 11:28
segments: Indeed as regards the gospel, [they are] enemies for your sakes. But as regards the election, [they are] beloved for the fathers' sakes.

entries.title: Romans 11:29
segments: For the free gifts and calling of God [are] without repentance.

entries.title: Romans 11:30
segments: For as you also then disbelieved God, but now have been shown mercy through their disbelief,

entries.title: Romans 11:31
segments: even so these also have not believed now, so that through your mercy they may also obtain mercy.

entries.title: Romans 11:32
segments: For God has shut up all in unbelief, so that He might show mercy to all.

entries.title: Romans 11:33
segments: O [the] depth of [the] riches both of [the] wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable [are] His judgments, and His ways past finding out!

entries.title: Romans 11:34
segments: For who has known the mind of [the] Lord, or who became His counselor?

entries.title: Romans 11:35
segments: Or who first gave to Him, and it will be repaid to him?

entries.title: Romans 11:36
segments: For of Him and through Him and to Him [are] all things; to Him be glory forever! Amen.
